decisions.executionNote: Begin symmetric elbow-up approach, tilting grippers toward the ruler while staying clear of the blocks.
Continue tilting and centering both arms above the two outer sections of the straightedge; no block contact.
Close the empty grippers and approach the near edge of the ruler with both tips, keeping the housings above the tabletop.
Advance the two closed tips evenly toward the near face of the straightedge, checking contact rather than assuming a grasp.
The ruler is sliding evenly under both tips. Continue a slow level push toward the nearest blocks without lifting.
Maintain balanced forward pressure on the straightedge so all three rear cube faces settle against the same line.
All three cubes now appear flush in a straight row. Withdraw both tips backward and slightly upward, leaving the ruler and cubes on the table.
The row remains aligned after withdrawal. Begin returning both arms toward their original poses while opening the empty grippers.
Continue the symmetric return along the same configuration, clear of the stationary aligned cubes.
